These kinds of questions are a little tricky, because most common notions of physics no longer apply to cosmological scales.

From the frame of reference humans can measure, the universe possessed the entirety of its energy at time zero, then immediately expanded very quickly (big bang). The total amount of energy in the universe does not gain or lose energy and may only change form (conservation of energy), giving rise to entropy (the available work a system may perform or have performed on it).

Asking where the energy of the universe came from, is to ask where the universe came from, and it is currently as such, an undefinable problem.
